summary: Iteration 94: full backend + frontend verification of the new shopping cart (sepet) feature and iter-94 regressions. Backend pytest (6/6): POST /api/orders with esim_3gb x2 + ins_15d x1 -> items_total=2040, bundle_discount=204 (10%), price=1836, source='store', ref='SV-...'; single-kind order -> discount=0; invalid application_reference DV-YOK123 -> 400 Turkish 'Bu vize basvuru kodu bulunamadi'; POST /api/orders/{id}/checkout -> Stripe checkout_url; GET /api/fx returns effective_rate + source + fetched_at; GET /api/products returns TRY prices with fx_rate. Frontend: /esim qty stepper + Sepete ekle -> navbar-cart-count '2' and plan-in-cart-esim_3gb text 'Sepette · 2 adet'; /esim?basvuru=DV-TEST99 shows plans-esim-application-note; /seyahat-sigortasi add ins_15d -> badge cumulative '3' (localStorage persisted across pages); /sepet lists both lines with cart-items-total='2.040 ₺', cart-bundle-discount='- 204 ₺' (10%), cart-total='1.836 ₺', cart-application-input pre-filled 'DV-TEST99'; +/- and remove buttons update totals; cart-clear-button empties cart and shows cart-empty. Empty submit -> Turkish toast 'Ad soyad girin.' (validation blocks). Bank-transfer checkout -> POST /api/orders success, redirect to /siparis/SV-... , cart badge cleared. Card checkout -> redirect to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... (URL only, no payment). Regressions: explainer subtitle box right=922 < image left=1014 (no overlap), 7 explainer dots present, sound/captions/toggle buttons present; visa-specimen open button width=448 (~matches text col), dialog opens with visa-specimen-full-image, ESC closes; navbar-logo-link scrolls from y=3319 to y=131, brand-flag-pair scrolls to y=1; pricing tab row center=960 exact center of 1920 viewport, switching tabs works. /hesabim login via OTP + account-orders block renders with completed orders and Sepetim shop button.
critical_code_review_comments: test_iteration_94_cart.py teardown fixture tried to parse backend/.env manually and choked on the URL '=' character — cosmetic (deleted_count assertion isn't strict). Left as-is; manual cleanup done via `orders_col.delete_many`. Consider using dotenv or the existing `db` module in future test fixtures.
Account rate-limit for OTP request is 60s server-side; tests that need multiple login cycles must wait between runs. Documented for next iteration.
